faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about booking with us.
faq.q1: How do I book an appointment?
faq.a1: You can book an appointment by navigating to the "Book" page from the main menu, selecting your preferred appointment type and provider, and choosing an available time slot.
faq.q2: Can I cancel or reschedule my appointment?
faq.a2: Yes! Check your confirmation email for a link to manage your appointment. Alternatively, you can click "Manage" in the navigation bar and enter your appointment token to cancel or reschedule it online.
faq.a3: A confirmation token is a unique 36-character code (UUID) provided to you when you successfully book an appointment. It acts as your secure "password" to access and modify your specific appointment later.
faq.q4: Is there a limit on how many appointments I can book?
faq.a4: Yes, to prevent spam and ensure fairness, our system currently limits patients to a maximum of 3 appointments per day.
faq.q5: Do I need to create an account?
faq.a5: No! Our system is designed for frictionless booking. You just need to provide your name, email, and phone number during checkout.
